Overview

Vila Nova de Gaia is a city in with a population of 302,295. Home to the world-famous port wine cellars, offering stunning views of Porto across the Douro River. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 46.0.
